chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, he said:
"She performs hajj, even if it displeases him."

key_terms.أَنْفُهُ: his nose; an idiom indicating his displeasure

ai.seo_question: Can a husband prevent his wife from performing the obligatory hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a woman is to perform hajj despite her husband's objection. It indicates the binding force of the obligatory hajj and that such an obligation is not nullified by a spouse's disapproval.
